info.name: MediCare AI Service
info.description: AI prescription-analysis microservice. Called only by the ASP.NET Core backend — see API_CONTRACT.md in the repo for full field-by-field documentation, confidence scoring rules, and error shapes.

variable.description: Production URL. Switch to http://localhost:8001 for local testing.
Must match the SERVICE_API_KEY environment variable configured on the AI service

request.description: Liveness check. No auth required. Returns status, version, and which model is currently configured.

formdata.description: GUID — passed through for logging only, the AI service does not query SQL Server
'ar' or 'en' — controls the language of generated instructions text, not what languages it can read

request.description: Core endpoint. Sends a prescription photo, returns structured medication data with per-field confidence scores. See API_CONTRACT.md §3.2 for the full response schema, all `flagged_for_manual_review` reason codes, and error responses (400/422/429/500).
Fuzzy-searches the same drug database the AI uses. Useful for a manual 'add medication' screen so names stay consistent with what /analyze can recognize.
